saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.
evaṃ vutte, uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo siṅgālaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna soṇḍipañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā app'ossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati.

30993.grammar: pr, pass, deno of tuṇhī, intrans

examples.text: taṃ nadīhi vijānātha, sobbhesu padaresu ca, saṇantā yanti kusobbhā, tuṇhīyanti mah'odadhī.

30994.notes: (MW) a goad for driving cattle or an elephant

examples.text: so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.

30995.meaning1: spike and ankus; pike and lance
30995.commentary: (DNa) tuttaṃ vuccati kaṇṇamūle vijjhana-ayadaṇḍako. tomaran'ti pād'ādīsu vijjhanadaṇḍatomaraṃ. aṅkuso'ti matthake vijjhanakuṭilakaṇṭako.

examples.text: accaṅkuso'va nāgo'va, jitaṃ me tuttatomaraṃ, kāraṇaṃ nappajānāmi, sammatto lakkhaṇ'ūruyā.
aṅgulipatodako nāma aṅguliyā'pi tudanti upasampanno upasampannaṃ has'ādhippāyo kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
n'ābhisajjī'ti kuṭilakaṇṭako viya tattha tattha mammaṃ tudanto viya na laggi.
